decisions.reason: The accent's existing derivation rule remains valid; the source refines the Hero V's right arm and silhouette without specifying a change to the accent.
The requirement already states that the second V derives from the Hero V geometry, and the source does not alter that rule or independently specify the second V.
The source addresses only the Hero V silhouette and right-arm reach; it does not resume or change the deferred E and L letterform requirement.
The source changes geometric refinement only and does not modify or resume the deferred champagne material treatment.
The Hero V refinement does not entail any change to the deferred full-wordmark kerning requirement.
Preserving the Hero V's confident silhouette and extending its right arm does not change the established hierarchy in which the closing V remains smaller and subordinate.
The client's clarification supplies design feedback but does not change the freelancer's obligation to include rationale with design rounds.
